task_title: Fix Floor 1 bow seed 35 release regression

plan_review.notes: Separate-model review approved with changes. Concern 1 (plan review timing) is recorded transparently as post-implementation because the human-facing issue plan was posted before coding but the separate-model review was missed until ledger setup. Concern 2 (projectile-wide behavior) addressed by expanding the wounded regression to cover fireball as well as bow while preserving existing healthy projectile coverage. Concern 3 (threshold coupling) assessed as acceptable because the behavior intentionally uses the existing ranged defensive HP threshold rather than introducing new tuning for this surgical fix.
